subject: horse
classification.basis: Entered from model recall on 2026-11-02, not yet checked. Check form, technique, support and condition against the holding institution's record or a catalogue raisonné (Marani 2000, Zöllner 2003; for manuscripts, the Edizione Nazionale or Pedretti).

claims.statement: Project for a monumental bronze equestrian statue of Francesco Sforza. A full scale clay model was shown in November 1493 and damaged in 1499. The bronze was never cast.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Court correspondence; Leonardo's notes and drawings.

value.text: Windsor design sheets RCIN 912357, 912358; casting studies RCIN 912351

claims.statement: Windsor holds designs for the monument including RCIN 912358 (recto rearing horse with rider over a fallen soldier; metalpoint on blue prepared paper; c.1485 to 1488) and 912357, and casting studies including RCIN 912351.

sources.cite: Royal Collection Trust, collection online, RCIN 912358, Recto: A design for an equestrian monument. Verso: Studies of flowing water, a cross bow, geometry, c.1485 to 1488. Read through search engine excerpts in this session; the page itself was not fetched in this session.

value.text: Note on the bronze horse, 17 May 1491

claims.statement: A Leonardo note reported as dated 17 May 1491 introduces a record of everything concerning the bronze horse; it is shown next to Madrid II f. 157r in an online gallery, but its folio is not confirmed.
